dataformat.name: hl7
dataformat.title: HL7
dataformat.description: Marshal and unmarshal HL7 (Health Care) model objects using the HL7 MLLP codec
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,health

marshalIn.description: A HAPI Message, or HL7 as text or bytes (ER7 or XML) or an HL7 XML DOM Document, which a type converter parses into a Message. A stream or a file fails: convert it to text first

marshalOut.description: HL7 in ER7 (pipe-delimited), or HL7 XML with targetFormat XML, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: HL7 in ER7 (pipe-delimited) or XML, which the parser detects

unmarshalOut.description: The HAPI Message of the structure for its type and version, such as ADT_A01 (a GenericMessage without the structures), with the MSH fields in CamelHL7 headers. With targetFormat XML, the HL7 XML as a DOM Document

parser.label: advanced
parser.description: To use a custom HL7 parser.

validate.description: Whether to validate the HL7 message.

targetFormat.description: The target format for marshal output and unmarshal result type. By default, marshal encodes to HL7 ER7 and unmarshal returns a HAPI Message object. If set to XML, marshal encodes to HL7 XML and unmarshal returns an XML DOM Document.
